text: The Patriots' Week 2 victory over the Steelers came at a cost: starting right guard Mike Onwenu suffered a broken right ankle that has landed him on injured reserve, prompting the team to sign punter Mitch Wishnowsky to the 53-man roster from the practice squad and add tight end Tanner Conner to the practice squad. While the defense delivered a dominant performance in man coverage during the 20-3 win—with TreVeyon Henderson punching in a touchdown as the team dominated Aaron Rodgers and company—film review reveals Drake Maye still has work to do finding offensive rhythm, though the young quarterback showed flashes against Pittsburgh's formidable defense. Now the Patriots turn their attention to a road matchup against the Jacksonville Jaguars at Everbank Stadium on Sunday, September 27 at 1 PM ET, looking to build on their defensive success while continuing to develop Maye's decision-making and timing. And if you need a palate cleanser from all the injury news: Adam Vinatieri, the Patriots' legendary kicker, recently set a Guinness World Record by converting a field goal at 3,454 meters atop the Jungfraujoch in Switzerland—proof that excellence in a Patriots uniform transcends even the laws of physics.
